findings.finding: [measurement] The answer key can leak to both arms: every prompt contains the JEV interpreter path, and JEV docs/runs/hard/README.md lists root cause and evidence line of every measured case.
findings.resolution: fixed in the measurement: the key-access check now also flags reads of the JEV docs/examples/tests/tool folders, docs/runs and shadow-eval, in both arms; it detects, it cannot prevent (see deviations)

findings.finding: [measurement] Arm B gets help unrelated to Jev (full log saved under .tool-output/, local anchors) while arm A only streams truncated output and may not create files.
findings.resolution: fixed in the measurement: arm A now also saves its full log to .tool-output/last.log and prints its path first; the [local] anchors stay part of the tool and cannot be split from the Jev hints with 2 arms (see deviations)

findings.finding: [context-curator] The default omitMaxP 0.2 was chosen on the same 19 scenarios (all 4 measured curator cases included); the margin is thin (h04 loses a gold pattern at 0.3). The result is in-sample.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed; reported as calibration data

findings.finding: [context-curator] alwaysKeep protects only Traceback and ERROR/CRITICAL; the gold evidence of h02 and h04 is a WARNING line, kept only if Jev p > 0.2.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed

findings.finding: [context-curator] A chunk is omitted whole, but Jev saw a text cut to maxChunkChars / filtered by noisePatterns, so a part Jev never saw can be omitted.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed

findings.finding: [jev_advisor] Redaction misses prefixed secret names (DB_PASSWORD=..., GITHUB_TOKEN=..., MY_API_KEY: ...): the leading   fails after an underscore, so values go to OpenRouter.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed

findings.finding: [jev_advisor] Chunks are cut to maxChunkChars before redaction, so a secret on the cut can be shorter than a rule minimum and pass.
[jev_advisor] '[jev] N other chunks checked, none flagged' counts chunks that were flagged but capped or deduplicated.
[jev_advisor] On POSIX the timeout kills only the direct child; a grandchild holding the pipe blocks past timeoutSec.
[context-curator] Tests are in-sample (one fixture), key assertions conditional; no test of truncated/skipped chunks or a WARNING evidence line.
[measurement] The contamination check misses reads of sibling work folders and is applied to arm A only.
findings.resolution: fixed in the measurement: collect_grade.mjs also counts tool calls that name another work folder (siblingReads) and the key check runs on both arms

findings.finding: [measurement] The cases may be too easy: the scenario source is 1-2 KB and points at the cause; either arm can read the source and grep the log for one line. For the curator the view is only 10-39% smaller.
findings.resolution: noted; stated in the report caveats
